newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF, MONEP in stocks derivatives venture.
newsitem.headline: MATIF, MONEP in stocks derivatives venture.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF and traded options exchange MONEP said on Monday they were setting up a joint company to operate and expand a range of future contracts on the CAC-40 stock index and other indices.
Stock markets association SBF will manage the company.

The three organisations said in a joint statement the new company's purpose was to reduce trading costs for members and their clients and favour more continuity between equities and equity derivatives by allowing new combinations of positions between these products.
